prompts.name: western
prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONLY the central full-body couple artwork for a wedding website, NOT a poster or UI. The attached image is a STYLE REFERENCE: emulate its charming hand-inked cartoon couple, expressive simplified faces, oversized black wavy hair masses, lively slightly imperfect thin black outlines, mostly black and white flat fills, whimsical hand-drawn romantic fashion illustration. NO realism, NO 3D, NO polished fashion portrait, NO watercolor shading. Pure white #FFFFFF background. Two young Punjabi adults in love, male LEFT with tousled solid black hair and full neat black beard, female RIGHT with long flowing wavy solid black hair. Warm happy expressions looking at one another. Full bodies HEAD TO SHOES uncropped with 4% white margin all around. Same ground line. Male black loose fit suit, white shirt, black tie, black shoes; female flowing white western midi dress with thin black outline, tiny black handbag, black heels. Reference-like relaxed pose, male hand in pocket, female hands clasped in front and one heel slightly lifted. Characters close yet separated by a small WHITE VERTICAL GAP at EXACT 50% image width: boy completely in LEFT HALF, girl completely in RIGHT HALF. No overlap across center. Both same size and no floating elements. Tall portrait 3:4 composition. NO text, NO hearts, NO frame, NO border.

prompts.name: western-lookbook
prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Attached image is the identity and ink-style reference. Create a single WIDE HORIZONTAL FASHION LOOKBOOK ILLUSTRATION STRIP on PURE WHITE background. SIX small full-body figures in ONE evenly spaced row, same head-to-shoe size and same baseline. First THREE figures are the SAME WOMAN from reference, long wavy solid black hair expressive cartoon face, wearing 1 black sleeveless elegant western midi dress, 2 muted olive green puff sleeve dress, 3 light ivory sleeveless western midi dress, all with tiny black bag and black heels. Last THREE figures are the SAME MAN from reference, tousled black hair and neat full black beard, wearing 1 black suit with white shirt black tie, 2 olive suit white shirt, 3 ivory suit white shirt, black shoes. Different relaxed fashion poses, warm happy smiles. Retain reference's imperfect black ink lines, simple flat fills and black hair masses. NO realistic shading, NO watercolor, NO 3D. Space figures evenly with a slightly LARGER GAP between figure 3 and 4 (the two groups). ALL hair AND shoes visible with 4 percent white margin. Absolutely NO letters, NO labels, NO text, NO hearts, NO frame. Wide landscape aspect ratio approximately 2.5:1.
